title: PAR-134 MPOLYGON fill CMC method, flags, and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1018/AC1024/AC1032 DWG fast slice plus focused DXF refusal/retry
scope: Retain MPOLYGON fill CMC source method, optional-string flags, and reserved index
Replay supported source C0-C3 metadata without losing flagged-empty names
Refuse unknown or inconsistent CMC state before DWG output
Prevent class-specific DXF output from silently normalizing unsupported source methods

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: R2004+ CMC contains a leading BS index that is always zero, a packed BL color/method, and an RC flag byte whose low bits indicate optional color-name and book-name TV strings. This slice preserves those source fields at the already-parsed MPOLYGON fill CMC location; it does not assert additional MPOLYGON body grammar or qualify unsupported methods.

localSource.finding: The MPOLYGON trailer parser previously retained normalized scalar/RGB/name/book data but omitted raw method, flags, and index. The writer inferred method from normalized state and regenerated flags from non-empty strings. The bounded color helper already decoded raw flags/index through dwgBuffer::getCmColor; it now exposes them as optional outputs.

productionSummary: Append DWG-only MPOLYGON fill CMC provenance fields after existing members to preserve their offsets; copy, assignment, reset, and DXF scalar/name updates maintain or clear them.

DWG fill-color preflight verifies C0-C3 method/scalar agreement, zero reserved index, known optional-string flags, and string/flag consistency before output; supported source flags are replayed exactly, including a flagged empty color name.

MPOLYGON DXF output now runs class validation and refuses C5 or other unsupported/mismatched CMC methods instead of silently projecting the normalized scalar. Existing unsupported color-book DXF policy remains fail-closed.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended fields increase DRW_MPolygon object size while preserving previous member offsets; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgRoundtrip: AC1018, AC1024, and AC1032 generated routes cover C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C2 black RGB, C3 indexed color, named fields, a flagged empty color name, and following-LINE alignment.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy construction, assignment, and reset retain/clear method, flags, reserved index, and presence state.
generatedControls.failClosed: Direct encoders reject C5, unknown optional-string flags, and a nonzero reserved index without changing body/string/handle buffers.
generatedControls.dxfProjection: An ASCII DXF control refuses C5 Foreground while preserving an existing destination, then reuses the same writer for a corrected C3 retry.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4

evidenceLimits: Generated local writer/reader round-trips verify implementation consistency, not independent producer semantics for MPOLYGON CMC fields.
No persistent fixture, external CAD application, independent semantic reader, full suite, or native Linux/Windows FreeCAD qualification was run.
Unsupported methods remain observable and fail-closed; this slice does not qualify C5 payloads or C4/C6-C8 semantics.
Findings/subplans remain 144/78; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
